customer-alex: Hey team — after migrating our bulk embeddings job to the new batch-import pipeline last night we started getting 429s and our org credits dropped to 0 ~3h before the monthly reset. Billing dashboard still shows refill scheduled at midnight. Can you confirm why we were drained early?

yana_support: Sorry about the interruption, Alex. Can you paste the org id and a snippet of the job config? Any retry loops or parallel workers?

customer-alex: org: org_abc123. Job is a multi-worker Python script using the v0.9 SDK. We switched from per-item embed calls to the new /v1/batch-embeds endpoint to speed things up. Rough config: 8 parallel processes, each sending batches of 512 items, retries on 429 with exponential backoff (max 5).

kai_backend: Thanks — that helps. Does the job span the monthly boundary (i.e., running across midnight)? Any evidence of duplicate submissions?

customer-alex: It started 45 minutes before midnight and ran ~2 hours. We do checkpointing but a few batches were retried after transient 5xxs. No intentional duplicates.

jen_sre: quick note: we saw a spike in tokens for org_abc123 at 2028-04-30T23:53Z — total tokens consumed jumped ~3x for ~20m. Logs show many concurrent batch responses and some retries recorded as new token usage instead of deduping.

kai_backend: That matches a suspected bug in counting for the batch-embeds migration path: older SDK call patterns (chunk+retry) can cause the request aggregator to double-count when a batch is acknowledged but the client retries due to a transient network error. We also have a race in the refill reconciler when a job spans the monthly refill window — partial refill + concurrent reconciliation could briefly allow additional token deductions and show 0 available in the UI while billing schedules refill.

yana_support: Can you provide simple repro steps so eng can validate? customer-alex, can you try a small run to reproduce (2 processes, 3 batches) and share logs? If you can't, we can reproduce internally.

customer-alex: I can run a reduced repro now. Quick log snippet from our run: ```
[2028-04-30T23:53:12Z] batch_send pid=12 batch_id=b-987 status=ack tokens=5120
[2028-04-30T23:53:13Z] batch_send pid=12 net_err=timeout retrying
[2028-04-30T23:53:13Z] batch_send pid=14 batch_id=b-988 status=ack tokens=5120
[2028-04-30T23:53:14Z] billing_event pid=svc tokens_deducted=10240 org=org_abc123
[2028-04-30T23:53:20Z] retry pid=12 batch_id=b-987 status=ack tokens=5120
```
Observation: we see the same batch_id ack then retry and another ack; tokens_deducted lines seem to count both.

kai_backend: Perfect repro log, thanks. That aligns with bug GH-rr/453: if an ack arrives but the client retried before network confirmation, the ingestion path currently credits consumption twice in some fast-paths for batch endpoints. We'll prioritize a patch.

jen_sre: Also the refill race: when a refill boundary happens while reconciliation is in-flight, the reconciler could mark an account refilled then process delayed consumption events that reduce the visible balance after UI shows refill — so end-user sees 'refilled' then 'zero' for short window. We're confirming a fix to make reconciliation idempotent and to treat mid-window inflight events as backpressure that can't create negative visible balance.

yana_support: Immediate options for you, Alex: 1) temporary manual top-up to restore capacity (we can grant a one-time emergency credit to let your job finish), 2) run reduced repro and pause long jobs across midnight, 3) upgrade SDK to the new client with retry-idempotency header (we'll share patch build). Which do you prefer?

customer-alex: Please do a manual top-up so we can finish the migration tonight, and we'll run the repro against your staging when you provide the patched client. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

billing-bot: Note: manual credit +50k tokens applied to org_abc123 by yana_support at 2028-05-01T00:05Z (internal ticket #SUP-12489).

kai_backend: Plan: patch aggregator to dedupe batch ack/retry within the window (hotfix), add server-side idempotency check for batch-embeds, and adjust refill reconciler to atomically apply refill before processing delayed consumption events. We'll aim to ship hotfix in ~4h and follow-up with a full revert-proof patch in next release.

jen_sre: Action items: (1) Support apply manual top-up (done), (2) Engineering push hotfix + monitor consumption delta, (3) SRE validate refill reconciler fix on canary and confirm UI/billing alignment. I'll post logs/metrics after canary.

yana_support: Thanks Alex — we've opened internal ticket SUP-12489 and ENG-9876; I'll DM you the temporary creds and the patched client once ready. :thumbsup:

customer-alex: Thanks everyone, that helps. We'll hold bulk runs away from boundary until hotfix verifies.

yana_support: Marking thread resolved when hotfix verified. If anything else, reopen. :white_check_mark:
